## About — https://www.80.cz/

Zbyněk Vanžura
PostgreSQL Specialist · Software Developer · AI Tinkerer
Prague, Czech Republic

### About

More than 20 years of experience in database architecture, software
development, and, more recently, AI-assisted engineering, with a
particular focus on PostgreSQL.

Builds open-source developer tools that make working with PostgreSQL
simpler — from an instant JSON-RPC API layer to schema exporters, dump
splitters, and a native SQL formatter, mostly written in Go and Python.

Writes about databases, software, and the occasional detour on the blog
Port 80, and shares quick PostgreSQL tips on Telegram — online as heptau.

## Projects — https://www.80.cz/projects/

Zbyněk Vanžura — projects and tools

- Port 80 — https://port.80.cz
  Zbyněk Vanžura's blog — practical insights from more than 20 years of
  experience, mostly about PostgreSQL, software development, and AI, but
  occasionally also about other topics worth reflecting on.

- PostgreSQL tips — https://t.me/postgresqltips
  Telegram channel with simple and effective PostgreSQL tips and tricks.
  @postgresqltips

### CLI Tools

- pgArachne — https://www.pgarachne.com
  Instant PostgreSQL API gateway — turn your database into a secure
  JSON-RPC API with zero boilerplate. Native MCP support for AI clients
  (Claude, Cursor), real-time SSE notifications, and database-native
  auth with RLS.

- pgDBML — https://pg_dbml.80.cz
  Export PostgreSQL schemas to DBML format for diagramming. Connect
  directly to a database or parse pg_dump output. Generates clean DBML
  ready for dbdiagram.io, Mermaid, or other visualization tools.

- pgAtropos — https://pg_atropos.80.cz
  Split PostgreSQL dumps into individual schema files for Git
  versioning. Creates separate files per object — tables, functions,
  indexes — ready for version control and code review.

- pgProcrustes — https://pg_procrustes.80.cz
  PostgreSQL SQL formatter in Go. Fast, flexible formatter driven by the
  native PostgreSQL parser. Supports keyword casing, data type
  formatting, layout, and clause breaking.

- TypoLima — https://typolima.80.cz
  Conservative typographic fixer for HTML, PHP, Hugo, and text files.
  Fixes quotes, dashes, non-breaking spaces, ellipses for 33+ languages.
  Only touches text content — never code, tags, or template variables.

### GUI Apps

- OmniDB — https://www.omnidb.net
  Open-source database management tool — lightweight, fast, and
  collaborative. Web-based GUI for PostgreSQL with schema browser,
  query editor, data explorer, and multi-user support.

- pgAdmin III — https://pgadmin3.80.cz
  GUI administration tool for PostgreSQL — missing macOS binaries.
  Available via pre-compiled app or Homebrew installation.

- SQLFluff UI — https://sqlfluffui.80.cz
  Cross-platform desktop app for configuring SQLFluff visually. Set
  dialect, indentation, and layout rules — see formatted SQL live. Built
  with Python and PySide6, no command-line knowledge required.

### Web Apps

- Compound Interest Calculator — https://compound-interest-calculator.80.cz
  Online compound interest calculator with history tracking. Calculate
  investment growth from initial deposit, contributions, rate, and
  time. PWA installable, works offline, includes calculation history.

- Odorik Dash — https://odorik-dash.80.cz
  Dashboard for monitoring Odorik VoIP credit balance and usage.
  Real-time credit tracking, call history overview, and service status
  for Odorik.cz customers.

- Odorik — https://odorik.80.cz
  Web app for managing Odorik VoIP services. Quick contacts dialer,
  call history with recordings, SMS composer with character counter,
  and account settings.

- QR Generator — https://qr-generator.80.cz
  QR code generator for text, URLs, Wi-Fi, geolocation, email, phone,
  SMS, SEPA payments, and Czech QR payments. Customizable colors and
  error correction with PNG download.
